rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides integration with Kroger's grocery API, enabling AI assistants to search for products, find store locations, retrieve detailed product information including pricing and availability, and manage shopping carts through OAuth2 authentication. Built with Python using the requests library and a custom AuthManager for token handling, it supports both application-level operations (product search, store lookup) and user-specific actions (cart management) that require customer authorization. The implementation handles token refresh automatically and provides comprehensive error handling for API rate limits and authentication failures, making it valuable for building grocery shopping assistants that can help users find products at nearby Kroger stores and add items to their carts through natural language interactions.
